root.speaker: Wend
root.text: You're the one who took the old outpost. Brave or desperate — out here they look the same.

lore.speaker: Wend
lore.text: A whole settlement, once. They left in a hurry the winter the cold came early — said the marsh to the north had 'turned'. I stayed. Someone has to remember.

lore2.speaker: Wend
lore2.text: Pell knows more than he says. Find him by the stones east. Earn his trust and he might tell you. Or show you.

gift.speaker: Wend
gift.text: Kindness, out here? I won't forget it. Here — a pattern I can't use anymore. Maybe you can.

trade.speaker: Wend
trade.text: I forage more than I eat. Trade you cooked meat for a waterskin?

choices.text: Deal (give full waterskin, get 2 cooked meat).

root.speaker: Old Pell
root.text: Hm. Another one. You'll not last the deep cold without iron and sense. I have iron. Sense you bring yourself.

warn.speaker: Old Pell
warn.text: The marsh took the cold and kept it. Things that should sleep through winter don't, up there. The others ran. I stayed to keep the forge lit, in case anyone came back. You came back.

trade.speaker: Old Pell
trade.text: Two ingots buys a proper iron axe. Fair, for out here.

traded.speaker: Old Pell
traded.text: Mind the edge. I don't sharpen twice.

teach.speaker: Old Pell
teach.text: You've earned a little trust. Here's how the old tailors lined a coat against the wind. Use it well.
